title: Anna and Her Family
text:
My name is Anna. I live in a small house with my mother, my father and my dog, Max. We have a big kitchen. Every morning, my mother makes breakfast for us.

My grandmother lives near us. She is seventy years old. On Sundays, we visit her and eat soup together. She likes to tell us stories about her childhood.

questions.text: Who makes breakfast for Anna every morning?
How does Anna feel about her grandmother?
Why does the family visit the grandmother on Sundays?
options: They want to see her and spend time together
They have to work in her house
They need to borrow money from her
They are going on a holiday

vocabulary.definition: a room where food is cooked
the first meal of the day
the mother of your father or mother
tales that describe things that happened

paragraph_translations: Nazywam się Anna. Mieszkam w małym domu z mamą, tatą i moim psem, Maxem. Mamy dużą kuchnię. Każdego ranka mama przygotowuje dla nas śniadanie.
Moja babcia mieszka blisko nas. Ma siedemdziesiąt lat. W niedziele odwiedzamy ją i razem jemy zupę. Lubi opowiadać nam historie z dzieciństwa.
